scope: Read-only review of frozen activation-vector terminology and expanded CPWL/DC construction sketches; no edits, builds or subagents.
mathematical_checks: Activation vectors are binary strict-positive ReLU indicators, distinct from activation values; hidden-layer dimensions and affine/ReLU output conventions are consistent.
Activation cells fix the complete vector; strict cells exclude included zero preactivations. Pooling refinement and unique-winner requirements retain the classical derivative scope.
Stopping-cell monotonicity, parity-path factors, SPNE policies and trajectory indicators retain their original meanings.

Regional blindness now assumes membership in a strict activation cell, which ensures a neighborhood with constant hidden masks. Zero affine output is correctly allowed. The path-product argument remains valid.
Maxout selection matrices retain >=0/<0 ties; their equality to diagonal activation-vector masks is restricted to strict cells. Smooth conditional gates remain separate.
Two-hidden-layer CPWL consequence is supported by the cited sources and by parallel composition of two-hidden-layer maximum networks with a signed affine readout.

Convex-fold proof is valid: every fold breakpoint lies in an extended shared-facet hyperplane; a generic line crosses distinct hyperplanes separately; positive jumps of f are compensated by their summands and remaining jumps of g-f are nonnegative. Continuity handles other lines.

Coincident hyperplanes or repeated affine pieces do not invalidate the argument: distinct hyperplanes are treated once for generic-line selection and extra summands add nonnegative jumps. An empty convex-fold sum is the affine zero function.
Farkas certificate signs are correct: A_i^T lambda = u_j-u_i and r_i^T lambda <= c_i-c_j. Nonempty full-dimensional cells suffice; boundedness is unnecessary.

All-pairs dominance yields max representations matching the desired affine pieces on each cell. The convex-fold pair is a valid feasibility witness after the common refinement, while the original partition has no blanket feasibility guarantee.
Nomenclature consistently separates activation values from binary vectors and correctly identifies L as the number of affine layers.

eq:delta_int_neg.semantic_check: The second component of the joint row-vector recurrence remains the negative pullback. Both stream-head choices, the one-half balanced-input convention, strict-tail derivative scope and ungated affine readout remain intact. Maxout ties still use the displayed >=0/<0 convention, distinguished from chi.

ptnb:eq:conditioned-bc-kernel.semantic_check: The conditioned-survival theorem still specializes the generic overlap chain rule to Doob kernels. Positive starting survival, joint-positive denominators, arbitrary completion of unreachable zero-survival rows, normalization and all physical proof witnesses are unchanged.

resolved_findings.resolution: Changed to strict activation cells of the underlying ReLU tail.
